changelog: Sign out is now a red pill and asks for confirmation.
Library + menu now offers Create playlist and Import playlist.
Import playlists from Spotify or YouTube Music links; Spotify songs are matched through InnerTube search.
Edit profile now matches the Sign in button style.
Onboarding starts with an empty display name so you can enter your own.
The app now requests the display's highest refresh rate for smoother scrolling.
Update and changelog now both read GitHub releases, so their notes always match.
